## R packages

::: {.work-grid}
[**ricecooker**[Analysis of agricultural field experiments — CRD, RCBD and split-plot designs, CV%, DMRT, data transformations, Type III SS, and ready-made plots]{.work-desc}](https://github.com/kanthjs/ricecooker){.work-card}
[**talatThaiR**[Fetch Thai agricultural price and production index data straight into R]{.work-desc}](https://github.com/kanthjs/talatThaiR){.work-card}
[**kanth_lib**[My personal R library]{.work-desc}](https://github.com/kanthjs/kanth_lib){.work-card}

## Apps

::: {.work-grid}
[**Rice Blast Forecast**[Rice blast disease forecasting tool]{.work-desc}](https://kanthjs.github.io/rice_blast_forcast_app/){.work-card}
[**Rice Pest Warning**[Rice pest warning based on historical survey data]{.work-desc}](https://kanthjs.github.io/rice_pest_warning_app/){.work-card}
[**RDstat**[Statistical analysis in the browser — R runs on your own machine, so uploaded data never leaves your computer]{.work-desc}](https://kanthjs.github.io/RDstat/){.work-card}
[**RBTool**[Plant breeding trial analysis in the browser — single-environment, multi-environment, and GxE / stability analyses (IRRI PBTools re-engineered with Shinylive)]{.work-desc}](https://kanthjs.github.io/RBTool/){.work-card}
